  FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day>=127 GROUP BY tenure, group_id ORDER BY tenure""")

  COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY ten ORDER BY ten""")

# 4. Issues

resolved = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day>={day-6} AND resolved_day<={day}")['rows'][0]['n']

print(f"  created last7d: {created} ({created/7:.0f}/day)")
print(f"  resolved last7d: {resolved} ({resolved/7:.0f}/day)")
print(f"  open: {o['n']}, avg age: {o['age']:.2f}d, oldest: {o['oldest']}d")

# 5. Billing buckets
print("\n--- Billing buckets (mod30) ---")

bd={x['bucket']:(x['n'],x['gross']) for x in r['rows']}
total=sum(x['gross'] for x in r['rows'])
tm=day%30
print(f"  today mod30={tm}, MRR gross(30d)=${total:,.0f}")

import novamind_api as nm
DAY = 133; CASH = 633404
r = nm.query("""SELECT billing_day_mod30 bd, COUNT(*) n, SUM(effective_price) rev
               FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY billing_day_mod30""")
bill = {row['bd']: {'n': row['n'], 'rev': row['rev'] or 0.0} for row in r['rows']}
MRR = sum(v['rev'] for v in bill.values()); NSUBS = sum(v['n'] for v in bill.values())
print('MRR/30d=$%.0f subs=%d ARPU=$%.2f' % (MRR, NSUBS, MRR/NSUBS))
OPS=1200; CAP=215; LEADACQ=48
CPU = 0.125   # compute $/sub/day (normal weeks; surge wks ~+$2.3k, partly self-funding via high receipts)
def sim(churn, label, cpu=CPU):
    cash = CASH
    bk = {bd: {'n': v['n'], 'arpu': v['rev']/v['n'] if v['n'] else 0} for bd,v in bill.items()}
    out = {}
    for d in range(DAY+1, DAY+1+185):
        mod = d % 30
        subs = sum(b['n'] for b in bk.values())
        cash -= OPS + CAP + LEADACQ + cpu*subs
        if mod in bk and bk[mod]['n']>0:
            b=bk[mod]
            b['n'] -= b['n']*churn          # churn-before-collect (churners skip final bill)
            cash += b['n']*b['arpu']
        da=d-DAY
        if da in (7,28,84,182): out[da]=cash
    fsub=sum(b['n'] for b in bk.values())
    print('%-8s churn=%.3f  +7d=$%.0f +28d=$%.0f +84d=$%.0f +182d=$%.0f (subs=%d)'%(label,churn,out[7],out[28],out[84],out[182],fsub))
    return out
print('--- churn-before-collect; churn=fraction/30d-bill ---')
opt=sim(0.030,'OPT'); base=sim(0.045,'BASE'); pess=sim(0.060,'PESS'); strs=sim(0.085,'STRESS'); xs=sim(0.110,'XSTRESS')
print('--- surge-compute sensitivity (BASE churn, cpu=0.14) ---')
base_hi=sim(0.045,'BASE+cpu',0.14)
print('\n=== SUMMARY (range across OPT..XSTRESS) ===')
for h in (7,28,84,182):
    vals=[opt[h],base[h],pess[h],strs[h],xs[h]]
    print('  +%dd: BASE=$%.0f PESS=$%.0f  range[$%.0f..$%.0f]'%(h,base[h],pess[h],min(vals),max(vals)))
